data.name: Buraqah
data.gender_notes: Buraqah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Buraq is an Arabic name for the celestial creature that transported the Prophet Muhammad on his Night Journey to Jerusalem and then to the heavens. The name Buraqah carries the meaning “Buraq: A celestial creature” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Buraqah usually hope their child will grow to embody buraq: a celestial creature and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing divine connection and spiritual elevation.
data.etymology: Buraqah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Buraq: A celestial creature.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Buraqah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: بُراقَة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من البرق يدل على السرعة والخفة
in_arabic.long_meaning: بُراقَة هو اسم مؤنث يأتي من جذر الفعل 'برق' الذي يعني السرعة والخفة، ويرتبط بالبرق الذي يقطع السماء بسرعته، وقد ورد في بعض الروايات الإسلامية كاسم للهفيدة التي حملت النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم من مكة إلى بيت المقدس.

in_urdu.name: براقہ
in_urdu.meaning: براقہ کا مطلب ہے تیزی اور خفی سے جڑا ہوا
in_urdu.long_meaning: براقہ ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے 'برق' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے تیزی اور خفی۔ یہ نام اسلامی روایات میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے، خاص طور پر اس کا تعلق اس وہیلے سے ہے جس پر نبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم مکہ سے بیت المقدس تک سفر کیا تھا۔

in_hindi.name: बराक़ह
in_hindi.meaning: बराक़ह का अर्थ है गति और तेजी से जुड़ा
in_hindi.long_meaning: बराक़ह एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के 'बरक' क्रिया से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है गति और तेजी। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में उल्लेखित है, विशेष रूप से इसका संबंध उस वहिले से है जिस पर पैगंबर मुहम्मद ने मक्का से बेत अल-मुकद्दस तक यात्रा की थी।

in_pashto.name: براقه
in_pashto.meaning: براقه د چټکتیا او روښانتیا معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: براقه یو مونث نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې د 'برق' فعل نه اخیستل شوی دی، چي معنی یی چټکتیا او روښانتیا ده. دا نوم په اسلامي روایاتو کې ذکر شوی دی، په ځانګړي ډول د هغې د تیز رفتار حیوان په تړاو چې رسول الله صلی الله عليه وسلم مکې څخه بيت المقدس ته سفر وکړ.

in_english.name: Buraqah
in_english.meaning: Derived from 'barq', meaning lightning, speed, and agility
in_english.long_meaning: Buraqah is a feminine name originating from the Arabic root 'barq', which signifies lightning, speed, and agility. It holds significant importance in Islamic tradition as it refers to the winged steed Buraq, upon which Prophet Muhammad traveled from Mecca to Jerusalem during his Night Journey (Isra' wal-Mi'raj). The name symbolizes swiftness, celestial connection, and divine transport.

data.cultural_impact: The Buraq is a significant figure in Islamic tradition and folklore, symbolizing the miraculous journey of Prophet Muhammad, known as the Isra and Mi'raj, in which he was transported from the Masjid al-Haram (in Mecca) to the Masjid al-Aqsa (in Jerusalem) and then to the heavens. This event is celebrated extensively in Islamic art and literature, and the name "Buraq" has become synonymous with miraculous journeys and spiritual liberation.
data.spiritual_significance: The Buraq represents the spiritual dimension of the world and serves as a reminder of the power and majesty of Allah, who is able to transport his prophet through the heavens in a single night. The creature is also seen as a symbol of divine guidance and the achievements of the soul in its journey towards spiritual enlightenment and the presence of Allah in the hereafter. The Buraq further highlights the belief in the unity of the physical and spiritual worlds, where everyday experiences can lead to profound spiritual realization.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Buraqah is a sacred animal in Islamic tradition, mentioned in the Hadith of the Prophet Muhammad's Night Journey (Isra and Mi'raj). It is described as a white animal with wings, symbolizing spiritual elevation and the ability to traverse great distances in a short time, embodying the concept of divine guidance and transcendence.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: The Prophet Muhammad is said to have made a night journey from Mecca to Jerusalem, then to heaven, on a winged creature called Buraq. (Sahih al-Bukhari 3252)

trends: Buraq is a popular name for horses and other animals in the Middle East and South Asia.
Buraq is also used as a name for mosques, schools, and other institutions in the Islamic world.
platforms: Buraq is a popular name for businesses and organizations in the technology sector, particularly in the Middle East and South Asia.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Buraqah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
